completion_criteria.text: 0092 diagnosis: the merge-boundary preflight never exits non-zero with empty stdout again - every non-zero exit emits a human-readable reason, and running the CLI directly with no MITOSIS_BOUNDARY_* env prints why it refused. Proven by executing the real CLI in that exact unconfigured state and reading its output.

0092 posture: a decision record settles whether the unconfigured boundary halts the run or degrades with a surfaced warning, and the engine implements what that record decides. The record must state the security trade-off explicitly, since fail-closed is what currently makes the engine unusable.

0092 receipt: a test execs the real preflight CLI end-to-end instead of stubbing the verdict, and it is RED when the step-7 call site is severed and GREEN when it is wired. The red state is demonstrated by actually severing the call site in a scratch copy, not asserted.

0093: gate identity stops being string equality on an unresolved path - the gate resolves a real path, or is relocated outside the repo it manages. A test redirects the path to a different file and asserts the gate refuses rather than trusting it.

0094: the config guard covers git worktrees - a write to a guarded path inside a real git worktree of this repo is held for human confirmation, asserted by a test that builds an actual worktree fixture rather than simulating one.

Each of the above lands as its own MSP through the centralized pr-create tool, and origin/main is verified fully green (full suite, exit 0) after each merge - re-derived from the remote, never from a possibly-stale local main.

open_risks: 0092 ROOT CAUSE (corrected): an unsatisfiable contract, not a severed exec. mitosis.js has no child_process; step 7 is prompt text (mitosis.js:3720). SKILL.md:43 mandates inline-only config while step 7 reads env and gets none. Obeying the docs guarantees failure; it never worked.

0092 AMPLIFIER: exits 0 and 30 emit the stdout verdict line; 31 and 127 emit none, so config-missing, gh-missing, file-missing and agent-failure collapse into one message (mitosis.js:130-131). The 242-byte stderr naming the missing vars is discarded.

0093 CONFIRMED, STRUCTURAL: invokedAs is raw process.argv[1] (preflight:369) string-compared at mitosis.js:150. Detects a different COPY, never a tampered same-path file. No self-hosted gate can attest to its own integrity. The real mitigation is 0094, not more gate code.
